SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( (("t0"."id">=:f1_low AND "t0"."id"<=:f1_high AND :f1_low IS NOT NULL AND :f1_high IS NOT NULL) OR (:f1_low IS NULL AND :f1_high IS NOT NULL AND "t0"."id"<=:f1_high) OR (:f1_low IS NOT NULL AND :f1_high IS NULL AND "t0"."id">=:f1_low) OR (:f1_low IS NULL AND :f1_high IS NULL)) ) AS "within",
(  ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS "COUNT___"
 FROM "main"."period_event" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."owner_id"="t0"."id" AND  "t0_t0"."issued" = :_s2_period_from ) )  ) AS "today",
(  ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS "COUNT___"
 FROM "main"."period_event" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."owner_id"="t0"."id" AND  "t0_t0"."issued" = :s3_period_from ) )  ) AS "yesterday",
(  ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS "COUNT___"
 FROM "main"."period_event" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."owner_id"="t0"."id" AND  ("t0_t0"."issued" BETWEEN :s5_period_from AND :s5_period_to) ) )  ) AS "inherited",
(  ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS "COUNT___"
 FROM "main"."period_event" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."owner_id"="t0"."id" AND  "t0_t0"."issued" = :s6_env_period_from ) )  ) AS "environment"
 FROM "main"."period_owner" AS "t0"
WHERE ("t0"."id">:s2_period_from)
ORDER BY "t0"."id"
